Description.description: Free-form natural language description. The description of the column.
Description.example: Gaze position x-coordinate of the recorded eye, in the coordinate units specified in this metadata.

Units.description: Measurement units for the associated variable. SI units in CMIXF formatting are recommended. Use 'NA' for normalised or dimensionless values.

Origin.description: Reference point from which the values in this column are measured or defined.

Format.description: Permitted formats for values in the described column.

Levels.description: For categorical variables: An object of possible values (keys) and their descriptions (values).

Delimiter.description: If rows in a column may be interpreted as a lists of values, the character that separates one value from the next.

Maximum.description: Maximum value a column entry is permitted to have.

Minimum.description: Minimum value a column entry is permitted to have.
